audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with Israel-tribe and multitude imagery; draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for sealing, twelve tribes, great multitude, Lamb shepherding.

verses.restored: After this I saw four messengers standing at four corners of earth, holding four winds of earth so no wind might blow on earth or sea or any tree.

familiar.text: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

verses.restored: And I saw another messenger ascending from sunrise, having seal of living Divine, crying to the four messengers to whom it was given to harm earth and sea,

familiar.text: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

verses.restored: saying: Do not harm earth or sea or trees until we seal servants of our Divine upon their foreheads.

familiar.text: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.

verses.restored: And I heard the number of those sealed: one hundred forty-four thousand sealed from every tribe of sons of Israel.

familiar.text: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.

verses.restored: From Judah twelve thousand sealed; Reuben twelve thousand; Gad twelve thousand;

familiar.text: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.

verses.restored: Asher twelve thousand; Naphtali twelve thousand; Manasseh twelve thousand;

familiar.text: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nephthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.

verses.restored: Simeon twelve thousand; Levi twelve thousand; Issachar twelve thousand;

familiar.text: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.

verses.restored: Zebulun twelve thousand; Joseph twelve thousand; Benjamin twelve thousand sealed.

familiar.text: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.

verses.restored: After these things I saw, and look, a great multitude no one could number, from every nation and tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before throne and before Lamb, clothed in white robes and palms in their hands.

familiar.text: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

verses.restored: They cry with great voice: Salvation/healing belongs to our Divine sitting on throne and to the Lamb.

familiar.text: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.

verses.restored: All messengers stood around throne and elders and four living creatures, and fell before throne on their faces and worshiped the Divine,

familiar.text: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,

verses.restored: saying: Amen. Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and strength to our Divine into ages of ages. Amen.

familiar.text: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.restored: One of elders answered, saying to me: These clothed in white robes, who are they and from where did they come?

familiar.text: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?

verses.restored: I said to him: My lord, you know. And he said: These are the ones coming out of great pressure; they washed their robes and made them white in blood/life of the Lamb.

familiar.text: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

verses.restored: Because of this they are before throne of Divine and serve him day and night in his temple, and the One sitting on throne will shelter them.

familiar.text: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.

verses.restored: They will hunger no more, nor thirst anymore; sun will not strike them, nor any scorching heat,

familiar.text: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.

verses.restored: because the Lamb in midst of throne will shepherd them and guide them to springs of waters of life, and the Divine will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

familiar.text: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

translation_notes: Israel-tribe sealing and multi-nation multitude are both preserved; do not erase either Israel or nations.
Great pressure is not glorified; it ends in shelter, shepherding, water of life, and tears wiped away.
safety_note: Do not racialize or weaponize the 144,000; the number is apocalyptic symbolic completeness tied to Israel imagery and followed by innumerable multitude.
